body:
filemark markdown has NO sanitizer (no DOMPurify) — rehype-raw is the only HTML gate and does not sanitize. Trust model = the .md file is author-controlled content; MV3 CSP (no eval, no inline script execution) is the safety boundary. Frontmatter is parsed by a regex (/^---?
([\s\S]*?)?
---?
?/) + the pure-JS 'yaml' package, NOT gray-matter (eval). extractFrontmatter always returns {frontData,body} even on YAML error — never assume frontData non-empty.
